title: 女の子のアイコン
subject_en: Round-friendly original girl avatar icons, each ONE head-and-shoulders portrait, centred, simple kawaii face, different hairstyles and hair colours, flat background-less. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ボブやポニーテール、おだんごなど、髪型の違う女の子のアイコン12点です。SNSやプロフィール画像に使えます。
